notes.title: Purgatorio - 2025/01/31 Update
notes.content:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]

[list][*]NEW FEATURE backported from [i]Part III: Paradiso[/i]: Test clips in the Character Voice Settings menu are now subtitled. This menu is accessible through the Individual Character Voice Settings button located in the lower left-hand corner of the main Config menu.[/list]
